WITH RECURSIVE demand AS (
    SELECT
        so.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        CAST(sol.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS quantity
    FROM sales_order AS so
    JOIN sales_territory AS st
        ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line AS sol
        ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        d.order_id,
        d.line_id,
        d.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        d.quantity * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM demand AS d
    JOIN product AS assembly
        ON assembly.product_id = d.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials AS bom
        ON bom.assembly_id = d.product_id
       AND bom.start_date <= d.order_date
       AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= d.order_date)
    WHERE assembly.make_flag = TRUE
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.quantity), 0) AS total_demand
FROM demand AS d
JOIN product AS p
    ON p.product_id = d.product_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'HB-T721';

       AND parent_product.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_code = d.product_code
       AND uc.valid_from <= d.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= d.order_date)
)

    FROM exploded_bom AS e

    JOIN bill_of_materials AS b

    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)

WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE;
